Graphic Design Internship

We're seeking a talented graphic design intern ready to gain real-world experience in a creative agency. This is your chance to turn design concepts into compelling visual stories. What You'll Gain: Hands-on experience with real client projects Mentorship from experienced design professionals Opportunity to build a diverse, impressive portfolio Potential for growth within our agency Insight into the professional design world Pro Tip: We value passion and creativity over perfection. Show us your unique design perspective. Ready to kickstart your design career? Let's create something amazing! 🚀

What you'll do

  • Create designs for websites, social media, and marketing campaigns
  • Develop eye-catching print materials like posters, brochures, and business cards
  • Collaborate on design projects that bring client visions to life
  • Transform initial concepts into polished visual experiences
  • Stay current with design trends and innovative techniques

What we're looking for

  • Design students or recent graduates with a strong creative portfolio
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)
  • Creative problem-solvers with a passion for design
  • Individuals who understand digital and print design principles
  • Strong communicators who work well in a collaborative environment

Interested?

Send us your details and we'll get back to you within a few days.
